rule_cases.name: site

list.name: deep flooding in 2050
list.why: more than 1.5 m of water in a 2050 monsoon surge; give it back to the sea

list.name: harbour edge
list.why: a continuous public edge and room for wetland and mangrove

list.name: old city
list.why: west of P D'Mello Road is the old city (Dongri, Bhendi Bazaar); context, not design ground. The rail yards there stay designable through the industrial rule.

list.name: shallow flooding in 2050
list.why: floods up to 1.5 m in a 2050 surge

list.name: rain hollows
list.why: rainwater collects here; keep it as storage

list.name: valleys
list.why: water runs here; keep the channel open for drainage, storage and wetland

list.name: valley buffer (provisional)
list.why: room either side of the channel, wider for bigger streams

list.name: sea-breeze edge
list.why: keep low near the water so the sea breeze reaches inland (Eco-machine heights)

list.name: industrial land
list.why: likely contaminated; clean-up comes before building

list.name: existing trees
list.why: mature canopy; build around it
